note: BCP 47 at nom. The registry publishes a set of subtags and no relation over this slice, so the resource must carry no order at all: that emptiness is what makes isA unanswerable rather than false. Distinctness comes from the parties' distinctness rule, stated in a separate file that lists the subtags it covers; the problems instantiate it, so no inequation between two subtags appears in the included files, and a build that started expanding the rule there would fail here.
